q: An almost periodic function f: ℝ → ℂ (Bohr) has the property that for every ε > 0 there exists L > 0 such that every interval of length L contains an ε-period. This is equivalent to:
opts: f being the uniform limit of trigonometric polynomials
exp: Bohr's theorem: almost periodic functions are exactly the uniform limits of trigonometric polynomials (finite sums Σcₖe^{iλₖt}). They are the continuous functions on the Bohr compactification ℝ̂ of ℝ.
